title: alchemilla frigens
intro: Alchemilla frigens, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia, characterized by its rosettes of rounded, toothed leaves and its spikes of small, greenish-yellow flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing menstrual cramps and heavy bleeding, as well as soothing digestive issues and wounds. Lady's Mantle is said to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Alchemilla frigens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
